args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
Checks: on every run, rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections all passed. No run used the width-free ratio, and no run had a roll back.
Summaries: no run's profile shape differs from the batch. The centre REGR peak is at 421 µm on every run. The batch MAD is very small, so some |z| values look large but the actual differences are small:
- REGR peaks run from 52.84 to 52.92 %/h, around a median of 52.89 %/h.
- Growth zones run from 674 to 695 µm. The shortest, r04 and r08 at 674 µm, are about 2% below the 689.5 µm median.
- The largest flank difference is at 410 µm on r01, r05 and r06, 11 µm from the 421 µm on the other runs.
Remedies: r04 and r08 each kept one remedy and passed every check afterwards. That is the normal path.
Flagged runs: none, so they have nothing in common to report.
